1.e4 c6 2.b4 d5 3.b5.strategy: A double gambit: Black can take the b5 pawn with ...cxb5 or the e4 pawn with ...dxe4. White has nothing developed and gets no real compensation for a pawn, which makes this a try for surprise rather than a sound plan.
1.e4 c6 2.b4 d5 3.b5.name: Caro–Kann Defence: Labahn Attack, Double Gambit
